# The Green Man Works

> Locally owned dumpster bag rental in Lehi, Utah, serving Utah County. Owner: Braxton. Phone and text: (801) 310-9023. Email: Thegreenmanworks@gmail.com. Address: 322 E 300 S, Lehi, UT 84043. Open daily 9 AM to 5 PM.

## Service
- Soft dumpster bags, 8 ft long x 4 ft wide x 3 ft tall, 3.5 cubic yards (606 gallons), up to 3,500 lb.
- Price: $150 for the first bag (delivery, crane pickup, disposal up to 3,500 lb). $80 for each extra bag at the same address. No rental deadline and no daily fee.
- Contractor pickup rate: $120 for the first bag, $70 for each extra bag at the same site.
- Bags are placed on a driveway or lawn within 8 ft of a clear curb (no city street permit needed) and lifted out by a crane truck, so nothing heavy drives on the driveway.
- Folded, a bag is about 16 x 16 x 3 inches. Contractors can keep a stack in the truck.
- Same-day delivery may be available when reserved before noon.
- Dirt, concrete, rock, brick, gravel, mattresses and stumps carry extra dump fees. A bag takes about 2 yards of clean topsoil.
- Not accepted: appliances, water heaters, electronics, tires, batteries, paint, oil, fuel, propane, chemicals, hazardous waste, asbestos, food waste, liquids.

## Service area
Lehi, American Fork, Alpine, Highland, Cedar Hills, Saratoga Springs, Eagle Mountain, Cedar Fort, Fairfield, Pleasant Grove, Vineyard, Orem, Provo, Springville, Spanish Fork, Salem, Elk Ridge, Woodland Hills, Payson, Santaquin, Genola, Goshen.

5.0 stars from 9 Google reviews (November 2026).
